narrative.overview: The system is a field notebook: the working surface of a summer expedition where facts are recorded plainly, days are read as a route, and the landscape is shown honestly rather than staged. It is clear and adventurous — the confidence of a well-run camp, not the noise of a marketing campaign. Its voice comes from a single condensed display face against a plain reading face. Depth is tonal: surfaces change by color field and by spacing, never by shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One decisive condensed display voice, one plain reading voice.
A 1280px shared frame with equal margins, matched to header and footer.
Full color fields instead of decorative cards, gradients, and hairlines.
Photography as evidence, with editorial reference material disclosed.
One authored motion moment per surface, transform and opacity only.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Verde lago appears once per surface as a full field. It is a place, not a decoration.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The bright brand emerald and gold survive only inside the shared heritage chrome. The Home body never uses them.

rules.name: The Two-Line Rule
rules.body: Every headline fits two lines at 1440, 768, and 390 px. Cut words before shrinking type.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Only the display, headline, and title roles use Barlow Condensed. Body copy never switches faces.

rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule
rules.body: Home, header, and footer share one 1280px frame and one pair of margins at every width.

rules.name: The One Dominant Thing Rule
rules.body: Each screen carries one element that wins: a headline, a photograph, or a statement. Everything else supports it.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow and no decorative hairline on anything that is simply sitting there. Shadow is reserved for genuine overlays such as menus and dialogs.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a tone change or with space, never with a line.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: The Home does not use rounded cards, glass panels, or floating pills.

rules.name: The Honest Crop Rule
rules.body: A masked photographic edge is only used when the mask comes from the real subject, not from a radial-gradient approximation.

dos: Do keep every headline to two lines, and cut words before shrinking type.
Do use Bosque de lenga for the primary action and the facts panel.
Do label editorial reference photography as reference in the same frame where it appears.
Do keep one authored motion moment per surface, using transform and opacity only.
Do match the shared 1280px frame across Home, header, and footer.
donts: Don't add resting shadows, glass panels, or decorative hairlines.
Don't use gradients, gradient text, or glows.
Don't repeat the same section layout twice in a row.
Don't present provisional photography as documentary evidence of the camp.
Don't add a stock Patagonia clip to fill a video slot; use real footage or none.
Don't animate layout properties, filters, or backdrop filters.
